comment: Back-cover copy per book. hook = one-line opener; blurb = 2 short paragraphs; bullets = 5-6 'INSIDE THIS BOOK' items. British English, no em-dashes.

y01-art-and-design.hook: Every child is an artist. This book just keeps the studio open.
y01-art-and-design.blurb: Four units, sixteen topics and a making studio of your own. Draw, weave, print, paint and build with a grown-up nearby, and keep the portfolio at the end of the year.
bullets: Sixteen topics across four units
Drawing, weaving, printing and painting
A modelled making in every topic
Four projects, and a gallery of your own to finish
Original watercolour illustration throughout

y01-computing-and-robotics.hook: A robot does exactly what you say. Not what you meant.
y01-computing-and-robotics.blurb: Behind the school there is a yard, a garden and a machine room. Learn to say things precisely, build instructions out of blocks, and find out what a machine is really doing.
bullets: Every Year 1 computing topic, in five units
Predict, run and compare on every unit
Real bug hunts, with the fix never printed
Projects along the way, and one big one at the end
QR codes, each printed in words as well

y01-english.hook: A word a day is nine stops along the way.
y01-english.blurb: Meet the friends who will read with you all year. Learn a new word best when your brain meets it nine times, then use it in your own story the same day.
bullets: Nine stops along the reading railway
Every new word met nine times, then used
Reading, writing, speaking and listening together
A story to share in every unit
Original watercolour illustration throughout

y01-global-perspectives.hook: Dear World, what is it like where you are?
y01-global-perspectives.blurb: One big question in every unit, and a letter to write back. Find out how other children live, play, learn and eat, then say what surprised you.
y01-global-perspectives.blurb2: Look outwards, ask kindly, listen carefully, and act.
bullets: One big question in every unit
Letters to and from the world
Ask, listen, compare and act, every time
Real photographs and real places
A project in every unit

y01-mathematics.hook: Count it. Check it. Then say how you know.
y01-mathematics.blurb: Down under the roots of the old oak there is a schoolroom. Otto the owl counts acorns, Hattie the hedgehog guesses and then checks, and Milo the mouse asks the question that matters most: how do you know?
y01-mathematics.blurb2: Sixteen units of real mathematics, six projects along the way and a counting fair of your own at the end. Every page is meant to be written in.
bullets: Sixteen units, six projects, a counting fair to finish
Every page meant to be written in
Count it, check it, say how you know
A second method whenever there is one
Original watercolour illustration throughout

y01-music-and-drama.hook: A whole year in the Hedgerow Theatre.
y01-music-and-drama.blurb: Wake your voice up in the green room, open the sound cupboard, walk the pulse along the long bench, build a journey out of sound on the platform, and put it all together on the full stage.
y01-music-and-drama.blurb2: Twenty-five topics, eleven traditional songs printed in full, and a big show at the end. Every rhythm counted, and every song's words free for everybody to sing.
bullets: Twenty-five topics across five units
Eleven traditional songs printed in full
Voice, singing, listening and composing
A big show to finish the year
Every song's words free to sing

y01-physical-education.hook: Run, jump, throw, and know why it worked.
y01-physical-education.blurb: Your first full year of physical education. Find the space, move safely, take your turn, and learn the games you will play for the rest of your life.
bullets: Every Early Years movement skill, in units
The rule of the game, printed every time
A decision to make on every topic
Named jobs, so everybody has one
A festival of games to finish the year

y01-portuguese.blurb: A primeira língua aprende-se a ouvir, a dizer e a brincar. Este livro acompanha as primeiras letras, as primeiras palavras e as primeiras histórias, sempre em português de Portugal.
bullets: Primeiras letras e primeiras palavras

bullets: Twenty-four topics across six units
Over 280 things to do, say and draw
A modelled enquiry in every single topic

y02-computing-and-robotics.hook: A robot does exactly what you say. Not what you meant.
y02-computing-and-robotics.blurb: That one idea runs through this whole book. Cross five stepped gates with Fen, Pip and Cog: write instructions that are clear and complete, build a program out of blocks, collect real data from your own survey, send a message across the room, and find out what is actually inside the machine doing all of it.
y02-computing-and-robotics.blurb2: Nearly two thirds of the practice in this book needs no screen at all, so the lesson happens whether the tablets are free or not.

y02-mathematics.hook: Draw it. Work it out. Then check it a different way.
y02-mathematics.blurb: Last year you learned to count something, and then to count it again to be sure. This book asks for the next thing, which is the thing that makes a mathematician: a method, and then a second, different method that agrees with the first.
y02-mathematics.blurb2: Otto draws the plan. Rook lines everything into rows and columns. Bramble keeps the store, the scales and the money tin. And Tessa checks every single thing a different way, which is why this book exists.
bullets: Twenty-one units covering the full Cambridge Primary Mathematics Stage 2 framework, with the objective codes printed on every unit
Over a thousand practice items, and not one printed answer to copy
A worked example, a reasoning prompt and a second method in every part

QR codes that only appear where the screen can do something the page cannot

y02-music-and-drama.hook: You can keep a sound by remembering it. Or write it down.
